_about: The one screenplay schema every stage reads (documented in stages/04-screenplay.md; a full example is examples/bakery-diwali/screenplay.json). Times are film seconds. rows[] covers every second from 0 to duration-1. Bibles are pasted verbatim into prompts: the shot's characters, then its location, then its props.
title: <working title>
continuity: References first: every keyframe is made from the character sheets and location plates, never from text alone.
Paste the bibles verbatim into every prompt.
No text, logo, emblem or number plate inside any AI frame. Every word is an overlay.

HERO.name: <name>
HERO.text: <HERO (age): face, skin, hair, eyebrows and eyes, build, fixed details such as a ring or a scar. Wardrobe (scenes): every garment, colour, fabric, footwear.>

PLACE.name: <place>
PLACE.text: <PLACE: walls, furniture in fixed places, which side the window and door are on; the time of day, the light source and its side.>

PRODUCT.name: <product>
PRODUCT.text: <PRODUCT: shape, size, colour, material; no print, no logo and no writing on it.>

voice.name: priya
voice.style: <who is speaking, to whom, in what mood; not an announcer>

music.prompt: <mood, instruments, tempo, length; no vocals, no choir, no humming>

captions.style: <colour, weight, position inside the safe zone>

shots.keyframe_prompt: <framing, angle, who is where, what each hand holds>
shots.motion: <one small action that fits in the shot; who stays where>

lines.tts: <what the voice says; Devanagari for Hindi and Hinglish>
